description: Journey-local event catalogue for JRN-012 (Direct Debit Setup and First Collection). These events are also appended to the central event catalogue at artefacts/central-model/event-catalogue.json. All events are published by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003) unless noted. Cross-capability events (affecting CAP-001) flow via SVC-102 (Event Bus). All financial events are routed to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111).

events.name: DirectDebitInstructionCreated
events.trigger: SVC-009 creates a DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034) with status = pending. Triggered either by (a) a channel API call (POST /v1/direct-debits) from PER-001 via the digital channel for customer-initiated setup, or (b) receipt of an AUDDIS 0N (new instruction) file from Vocalink/BACS for originator-initiated setup.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009). Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for account association awareness, SVC-053 (Notification), and SVC-103 (Audit). Crosses CAP-003 → CAP-001 boundary.

payload_schema.reference: string — max 18 chars, originator's customer reference
payload_schema.fixed_amount: decimal | null — present only when amount_type = fixed

consumers.action: Records awareness of new DDI against account_id for account management display purposes. Does not gate any account operation — informational only at this stage.

Sends 'Your Direct Debit is being set up' informational notification to the customer for originator-initiated DDIs (setup_channel = paper | auddis_originator). For digital channel setups, the channel already shows confirmation — SVC-053 sends a follow-up email confirmation.
Creates WORM audit log entry for mandate creation. Required for regulatory evidence of DDI lifecycle events under BACS participation rules.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic payments.direct-debit. All JRN-012 events for a given account_id are sequenced within the same partition.
events.worm_rationale: Contains account_id and originator financial relationship data. BACS scheme audit obligation. Retained for 7 years (PRA regulatory retention).

events.name: DirectDebitInstructionValidated
events.trigger: SVC-009 completes validation of the DirectDebitInstruction and updates ENT-034.status = active after receiving BACS AUDDIS confirmation. All scheme validation checks pass: account details valid, originator SUN active, no duplicate DDI. AUDDIS 0N has been submitted and accepted by BACS. May also be published on BACS ADDACS confirmation receipt.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009). Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to update account management state, SVC-053 for customer notification (including DD Guarantee disclosure), and SVC-103 for audit.

payload_schema.bacs_reference: string — BACS scheme reference assigned on confirmation

consumers.action: Updates account management state to reflect active DDI. Enables display of active Direct Debits in customer account dashboard.

Dispatches DDI confirmation notification to customer: originator name, BACS reference, first collection date (if known), and Direct Debit Guarantee summary. This is the mandatory disclosure of indemnity claim rights.
WORM audit record of mandate activation with bacs_reference. Constitutes the regulatory evidence of DDI lifecycle under BACS scheme rules.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic payments.direct-debit.
events.worm_rationale: Mandate activation is a regulated financial event under BACS scheme rules. 7-year retention required.

events.name: DirectDebitCollectionSubmitted
events.trigger: SVC-009 creates a DirectDebitCollection (ENT-035) with status = submitted after receiving the originator's collection instruction from BACS at D-2 (2 working days before the collection date). The collection has been validated against the active DirectDebitInstruction.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009). Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for upcoming transaction visibility, SVC-053 for advance notice notification to customer, and SVC-103 for audit.

consumers.action: Surfaces pending Direct Debit collection in the upcoming transactions section of the customer account dashboard for collection_date visibility at D-2.
Dispatches advance notice notification to customer: originator name, amount, collection date. Best practice under Consumer Duty for both fixed and variable Direct Debits.
WORM audit record of collection submission. Required for BACS scheme audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic payments.direct-debit.
events.worm_rationale: Collection submission is a financial event. 7-year retention required.

events.name: DirectDebitCollectionProcessed
events.trigger: SVC-009 receives confirmation of successful account debit from SVC-001 (CAP-001) via the event bus (SVC-001 publishes AccountDebited after SVC-009 publishes the cross-capability debit request event). SVC-009 updates DirectDebitCollection.status = collected and publishes this event.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009) after consuming AccountDebited from CAP-001 (SVC-001). Consumed by SVC-053 for post-collection notification and SVC-103 for audit.

consumers.action: Dispatches post-collection confirmation notification to customer: originator name, amount collected, date.
WORM audit record of successful collection. Required for BACS scheme reconciliation and regulatory audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic payments.direct-debit.
events.worm_rationale: Successful collection is a financial event. 7-year retention required.

events.name: DirectDebitCollectionReturned
events.trigger: SVC-009 updates DirectDebitCollection.status = returned after either: (a) SVC-001 signals insufficient funds (SVC-001 cannot debit the account on D-0), or (b) SVC-009 submits an ARUDD (Automated Return of Unpaid Direct Debit) to BACS. The return_reason is populated with the BACS ARUDD code.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009) on collection failure. Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to record the unpaid event, SVC-053 for customer notification of unpaid DD, and SVC-103 for audit.

payload_schema.amount: decimal — attempted collection amount in GBP
payload_schema.return_reason: string — BACS ARUDD reason code (e.g. ARUDD-1 Refer to Payer, ARUDD-B Account Closed)

consumers.action: Records unpaid Direct Debit event against the account for account management and transaction history visibility.

Dispatches unpaid Direct Debit notification to customer: originator name, amount that could not be collected, reason (customer-friendly language), and advice on ensuring sufficient funds for future collections.
WORM audit record of unpaid DD and ARUDD return. Required for BACS scheme audit trail and Consumer Duty evidence.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic payments.direct-debit.
events.worm_rationale: Unpaid DD return is a financial event with regulatory implications. 7-year retention required.
governance_references: Consumer Duty — clear communication on unpaid DDs

events.name: DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled
events.trigger: SVC-009 receives an indemnity claim from the customer (via channel API call POST /v1/direct-debits/{ddi_id}/indemnity-claim). SVC-009 validates the claim against the DirectDebitCollection record, updates status = indemnity_claimed, and publishes this event. The DD Guarantee requires the bank to act immediately on the claim — consumption of this event by SVC-001 triggers the account credit.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009). Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to credit the customer account immediately under the DD Guarantee. Also consumed by SVC-053 for indemnity confirmation notification and SVC-103 for audit. Critical cross-capability financial event.

payload_schema.claim_id: string (UUID v4) — indemnity claim identifier (SVC-009 generated)
payload_schema.account_id: string (UUID v4) — account to be credited
payload_schema.claimed_amount: decimal — amount to credit in GBP
payload_schema.collection_date: string (ISO 8601 date) — date of the disputed collection
payload_schema.claim_reason: string (free text, max 250 chars) — customer-provided reason for the claim
payload_schema.mandate_cancel_requested: boolean — true if customer requests the DDI to be cancelled as part of the claim

consumers.action: CRITICAL — must process immediately (< 30 seconds) to meet the DD Guarantee 'immediate refund' obligation. Credits claimed_amount to the account. Publishes AccountCredited event. Processing priority: high — consumer group for this event must have low-latency SLA.

Dispatches indemnity confirmation notification once AccountCredited is received: amount credited, mandate status (cancelled or remaining active as per mandate_cancel_requested), BACS indemnity claim reference.
WORM audit record of indemnity claim with full payload. Required for DD Guarantee regulatory evidence and Consumer Duty complaint handling records.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic payments.direct-debit. CRITICAL: SVC-001's consumer group for this topic must guarantee at-least-once delivery with deduplication on claim_id (idempotent credit).
events.worm_rationale: Indemnity claim is a regulated financial event under the Direct Debit Guarantee. 7-year retention required for Consumer Duty and BACS dispute resolution evidence.
governance_references: Direct Debit Guarantee — immediate refund obligation
